verdict.rationale: Moneybird is accounting software, so posting manual journal entries is a fair axis for it. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions journal entries, balanced debit/credit postings, or memos on ledger entries. The cited material covers authentication, contacts, invoicing, webhooks, sandboxes and API versioning only.

support.subject: As an accountant, I can post manual journal entries with balanced debits, credits, and supporting memos
